flag.reason: KIT mutation is required only for the GIST and non-CNS solid tumour cohorts, not for the CNS/glioblastoma cohort; whether this counts as candidate-matched enrichment for a GBM-eligible trial affects the primary outcome.

coder_notes: Phase 1 drug-drug interaction basket (GIST, KIT-mutant solid tumours, recurrent CNS tumours including glioblastoma; glioblastoma named in inclusion criteria and keywords). Avapritinib is the investigational antitumour drug (CNS patients continue to Day 56); midazolam is a CYP3A4 probe substrate, coded diagnostic_agent (measurement-only use; not a candidate under any reading). Only plasma PK planned, so tumour_pk no. KIT mutation coded enrichment (required for GIST/solid tumour cohorts only; single registered arm so arms left empty) and candidate-matched to avapritinib, flagged uncertain as it does not apply to GBM patients. The CNS cohort lists WHO CNS5-style entities (IDH-mutant astrocytoma, H3K27-altered DMG) as diagnostic categories; these are not entry requirements on one marker state, so IDH and H3K27M were not recorded as biomarkers. cns5_terminology unclear: glioblastoma is not defined with IDH-wildtype and WHO CNS 2021 is not cited, although the entity list follows CNS5 naming.
